posts.body_html:
I've been trying to make mental notes about S. x 'Elaine Wang' and S. x 'Ellie Wang' regarding how they are similar and different than each other. I've seen you mention that S. x 'Ellie Wang' is an "improved" version of S. x 'Elaine Wang', but I wonder if you still feel that way or if maybe they're both equally good on different merits.

Similarities:
White hood with red veins
Red tube

Differences:
S. x 'Ellie Wang' is taller, more vigorous and wider upper tubes

To me, being shorter with narrower tubes isn't actually something I'd ding S. x 'Elaine Wang' for since it's the color scheme that really makes these two clones pop rather than size. I feel like I'd almost prefer the more compact growth form of S. x 'Elaine Wang'.

Any chance we'll be able to see any side by side comparison pictures of these two clones in the coming year?

posts.body_html:
Sure thing, I'll try to get a pic of them side by side next growing season!

The main reason I never released Elaine Wang is because of it's growth habit: it produces nice spring and fall traps, but during the summer, it's very leucophylla-ey and produces only phyllodia. Sometimes, it's hard to coax the clone to produce nice fall traps. Ellie wang is far superior performance-wise, it just keeps producing traps all grow season long and is far easier to grow in general (eg. not as rot prone compared to Elaine Wang). The color of the body of Ellie Wang is arguably a bit more refined...the rounder/more symmetrical shape of the mouth is also subjectively more desirable.

posts.body_html:
So technically speaking, this clone isn't officially registered and has never been distributed. Why bring that up? Well, truth be told, ever since my wife (Elaine Wang) found out about S. 'Ellie Wang,' she's been bent out of shape about this plant, but maybe I can metaphorically "compost" the name of this clone and name something else Elaine Wang in the future? LOL challenge is, there still has to be one named after Benny Wang (my son) to be fair, otherwise Daddy's playing favorites with Ellie....naw, don't want to hear about that!

This Elaine Wang clone is nice, just not as good as Ellie Wang, and Ellie Wang looks like a super refined, way better version of Elaine Wang! Anyways, some updated pics of Sarracenia Elaine Wang, pics taken 5/22-ish/23;
